A Regenerar is a regenerative agency and communication platform that promotes regenerative culture as the main tool for natural, social and economic regeneration. Born out of the work of Astrid Vargas and her initiative Inspiration 4 Action, A Regenerar has become Spain's first regenerative influencers, creating regenerative content on social media to drive a change of mindset in society.
Alianza formada por ocho entidades que u: An alliance of eight organisations that use landscape restoration as a teaching tool from the Altiplano Estepario. It provides tools to train, inspire and empower people and communities.
La Alianza para una Educación Regenerati: The Alliance for Regenerative Education is made up of eight organisations that use landscape restoration as a teaching tool from the local setting of the Altiplano Estepario in south-east Spain. The alliance aims to provide tools to train, inspire and empower people and communities to co-create a more prosperous, equitable and harmonious future.

Empresa comercializadora de productos ec: A company marketing organic and regenerative products, founded in 2016 by farmers. The territory's first 4R business case, it connects regenerative farmers with European markets through regenerative organic almonds.
Almendrehesa S.L. es una empresa comerci: Almendrehesa S.L. is a company marketing organic and regenerative products, founded in 2016 by farmers of the Altiplano Estepario. It is the first business case of Commonland's 4 Returns (4R) model in the territory, and has become a key tool in the transition from a regeneration model that depends on outside support to one that is truly sustainable and self-sufficient.

Asociación sin ánimo de lucro fundada en: A non-profit association founded in 2016 that works on the comprehensive restoration of the Altiplano Estepario landscape through regenerative practices that improve soil and biodiversity and generate sustainable economic development.
AlVelAl es una asociación sin ánimo de l: AlVelAl is a non-profit association founded in 2016 that works on the comprehensive restoration of the Altiplano Estepario landscape, a cross-provincial territory spanning comarcas of Granada, Almería and Murcia. The territory is one of the poorest in Spain and at greatest risk of depopulation and desertification, but it also has great ecological and landscape potential.
Su objetivo es transformar la realidad s: Its aim is to transform the socioeconomic and environmental reality of the territory through regenerative practices that improve the soil, manage water, increase biodiversity, and generate sustainable economic development that helps keep people in the area.
de enfoque integral de regeneración del: of an integrated approach to landscape regeneration

AlVelAl es una asociación sin ánimo de l: AlVelAl is a non-profit association made up of people and organisations from the territory, mainly farmers. The association has grown significantly, from 70 members in 2016 to 517 in 2023.

el órgano encargado de la gestión, admin: the body responsible for managing and administering the association and representing its interests.
el órgano supremo de gobierno de la Asoc: the Association's supreme governing body, made up of all member people and organisations. General Assembly decisions are taken by majority. The Assembly elects the Board every two years.
AlVelAl desarrolla actuaciones de restau: AlVelAl carries out ecosystem restoration with the aim of creating a green corridor for biodiversity, working on both public and private land through land stewardship agreements. The work includes revegetation with native species, rebuilding water infrastructure and managing natural areas to improve ecological connectivity and the territory's water security.
51.000 nuevas plantas plantadas en actua: 51,000 new plants planted in revegetation and assisted restoration work

The aim is to reach as many farmers in the territory as possible so they start regenerative practices, using existing ones as beacons or examples to teach others.

AlVelAl trabaja en dos niveles para desa: AlVelAl works on two levels to develop regenerative business cases: promoting business cases in the Altiplano territory and an international strategy to increase the value of the regenerative chain. The aim is to create an ecosystem of regenerative business cases that generate financial return while contributing to the regeneration of the territory.

AlVelAl trabaja intensamente en investig: AlVelAl works intensively on research into regenerative farming techniques to give the farming sector solid scientific data. Understanding the effects of cover crops, the influence of livestock in regenerative agriculture, carbon sequestration, and the ecosystem benefits generated. Sharing results in the territory with farmers and the general public.
AlVelAl desarrolla proyectos que ponen e: AlVelAl develops projects that bring out the value of the territory's own resources (natural, agricultural, tourism, cultural and monumental heritage, traditions) to create sustainable development and help keep people in the area. It especially wants to develop gastronomy and agro-gastro experiences, creating an eco-destination that links the health of the land with the health of people.

Fundación Aland nace en 2021 con el obje: The Aland Foundation was born in 2021 with the aim of driving landscape restoration initiatives through the four-returns philosophy in the Iberian Peninsula, a model developed by the Dutch foundation Commonland. That same year, Aland formed an alliance with the AlVelAl Association to work together on the restoration project the association is carrying out in the Altiplano Estepario in south-east Spain.
Aland es catalizador de este proyecto y: Aland is a catalyst for this project and wants to inspire other initiatives in the Iberian Peninsula to create a territory that is resilient to climate change.

: Incrementar la resiliencia del entorno: : Increase the resilience of the environment, improve the soil and biodiversity, and manage water sustainably
: Crear puestos de trabajo, redes de con: : Create jobs and professional networks and generate added value, energising the economy and improving quality of life in rural areas
